December Update 2022

Features
[previewyoutube=lmS7cl-WHDQ;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
added No Fail mod 
- submits score but loss of all hp decreases total score by 50% and locks hp to max to remove low hp effect, older maps are going to have 0% loss to not break previous No Fail in multiplayer
added map option to change default No Fail mod score decrease
added Autoplay mod

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/852ad77f06533723796e947bd9b9e2cb1f1adeac.png
added Analysis Duration map option (Beats Timings category)
- allows to spread targets evenly across whole duration of a map (for ex. instead of 600 targets in 1 min song generator can look for 10 target every 1 second, low values recommended for aim training)
added automatic global chat messages when player: creates multiplayer lobby, creates or updates a workshop map 
added number of active multiplayer lobbies in top panel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/cad69c41411410e9a3c3d4f83e89aab8d12e1388.png

clicking maps in menu for 1 min, before/after:

better aligned settings ui
new tick box
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/2fb9183e44be174dbf487ab35d95b7b44d16d16b.png
added "Audio beat offset" to UI settings (was available before with O + Scroll while playing) 
max BPM increased from 600 to 1000 
added reset to default button for all settings tied to colors
added custom targets colors for all types (normal, slider, nopath slider, arrow)
default outline made 5% less bright, added option to customize it in settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/940666fd86a6f965c200f35378b6304916ab45bd.png


Fixes

fixed not being able to buy patron tickets for fixed price
fixed past legendary patrons not visible in game credits
fixed "Give role" button in profile panel not assigning patron roles
increased precision of game logic tied to targets size and target to beat sync when running the a game for long time (microseconds probably not very noticeable) 
fixed some words being invisible in non-english version of the game
default map fps optimizations
fps/stutter optimizations
fixed incorrect particle colors for destroyed arrow and no-path targets
particle color will now match custom target colors
fixed score pop ups not appearing sometimes with 3d map backgrounds


What's next?
Simple maps creator
There way too many options for new players to create anything. Some of them are too complex to understand as there aren't any examples. Beat Aim PhD
shouldn't be required to make a good map.

Creator will have several pages, every page few easy to understand images that can be selected.
3 buttons at the bottom: Back, Skip All, Next.
"?" in top left explaining what settings current page changes.

Later on it could also be use as simpler editor that changes several settings at once.

notes.title: July Update - better maps rotation, events, patron tickets
notes.content:
July Update 1.06b - 17 July 2022

It took some time but most of Beat Aim online services were finally moved to one place. Many actions are more responsive and developing the game got a lot easier!

Mapping League Update
Maps rotation will be run every 2 days, instead of one month. One map is going to be replaced and mapper will get a new shiny patron ticket box giving patron ticket for a day.

Speaking of tickets they're the first items in Beat Aim integrated with Steam Inventory and Marketplace. You can send or sell them to other player. They were implemented to allow you to exchange league rewards to Steam Wallet $.

Features

New 'Events' tab showing dates of rotations and esports/streamers leagues details
One ranked map rotates every 2 days
Mapper gets "random patron box" that contains gold, epic or legendary patron ticket for a day
Ranked maps sorted based on date they were added
Every new ranked map is locked for a week
Maps rotation updates automatically and doesn't require game restart anymore

All leaderboards were moved from Steam to our own solution to fix scores being reset on Steam maintenance. This also means we can go beyond Steam limit of 10,000 leaderboards. Additionally Ghost Scores (instead of being send to Workshop) are uploaded to our own storage. It makes loading and sending them much quicker.

Few bug reports that got fixed:
The selected gun volume won't save when put to 0 (when it's done directly in the settings). It saves correctly when put at higher or lower number.
suggested by NightBlast12

Ghost score may not work if player doesn't have steam workshop agreement accepted (add warning on result panel).
suggested by Kamyker

Scores getting reset on both ranked and workshop leaderboards.
suggested by Icey

Infinite loading after entering a wrong key for beat dollars.
suggested by NightBlast12

Slight hiccup at the start of every game.
suggested by Pextim

notes.content:
Features:

Smoother gameplay and improved latency due to Unity engine update (2020.1 -> 2020.2), more info
Lower input lag with Max Queued Frames option - default is 2, set to 1 for less latency but worse fps, more info
Input pooling rate option
Edit map panel split into sections

Better mp3 songs integration - music streaming in menu (less lag when selecting mp3 map) and fix for some of mp3 songs import not working
Improved Sprint mode movement, player is no longer is dragged to the side on loud beats
Customizable movement speed in Ninja mode

Bug fixes:

Attached ghost scores are not deleted from workshop sometimes
Additional preview workshop image doesn't work for visual maps
Alt tabbing for a rather long time ( say more than a minute) after having exited a map gives infinite loading screen [suggested by Nayllo]
Song has to be downloaded again on generator after uploading it to workshop, and download won't Work and then I can't launch the game anymore [suggested by Nayllo]
Safe for content tag not visible before downloading a map
Map without song when user uploads a map with local song not located in map folder
Mouse x/y broken scales, on game restart the non scale gets scaled to the same scale and both scale options will only do it for x [suggested by Burger]
Can't click on Other\Workshop after having uploaded a map [suggested by Nayllo]
Can't download a song because it's not available in a country, but I can after I restart the game [suggested by pierre659]
2 game mode tags for single map


Thanks to following players for their contributions and ideas! 
5 - Nayllo
2 - Burger
1 - Avery

Plans for next patch:
Prepare yourself... VIP is getting removed - Generator and Workshop will be finally free! There will be new optional way to support Beat Aim that hopefully will cover the cost of cloud generated maps for all players.

notes.title: 5.00a Update - Steam Workshop, New Mode, Modding and 30 more...
notes.content:
Major Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/32a249bbca0764b9493c683d7daee0b38530f3e8.jpg
Steam Workshop
Have you just created the best map ever existed in BeatAim?! Go ahead select your map, click "Workshop", "Update" wait few seconds for the amazing text "Success" and... Well you have to wait little more, like 2-3 mins for Workshop to refresh. Your map will show up in Workshop ingame tab. It will also get leaderboard assigned (that you can reset anytime you want).
Remember that everytime you play your map it will be validated to make sure noone is cheating. If you want to modify it use "Play Test" button when testing your changes. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/05f80ff1b25a71834d89dfd1bd69b78f75915be2.gif
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ New "Precise" game mode
Greatly rewards accuracy over speed. Targets appear instantly and rhythm bonus is heavily reduced. Can ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ be changed in map.json config under "GameMode" option.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/340f06eddd09e9e64f8b2c64501b20c012f7df9c.gif
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ New gun M249
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ Special feature - rapidfire while shooting sliders



Modding - Custom 3d visual maps made in Unity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/954daa2dda531fa2f370748419e4bd5a53acce7d.jpg
This is big one bringing limitless possibilities, including: 3d models, textures, materials, shadows, lighting, animations (and animators), shaders!, backward compatibility across different Unity versions and even whole scenes. Possibly this feature will also work in upcoming multiplayer mode. Guide on how to export a map inc soon.


All songs/maps are free
Previously maps had to be unlocked and then level up using in-game coins. It was rather annoying and got removed. In future this progression system will be replaced by map achievements.



Downloading libraries (like youtube-dl) as Steam workshop items
Previously players had to go through tiresome process of downloading additional files to be able to download songs. Not anymore! One click and it's done. BeatAim may also work with any other libraries that output .ogg files.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/dd71652415f0de62aad0b1a83c189ad064675098.jpg
Adding/Updating mass songs with csv, google sheets etc
Let's say you've uploaded 20 maps to workshop and one day you've decided to change all of them. No problem, if you follow file format similar to this sheet you'll be able to copy it (yes just click ctrl+A, ctrl+C) and update them all at once (buttons: "Advanced" then "Bulk update from .csv"). Don't forget to upload your changes to the Workshop and reset your leaderboards if needed.


Custom Leaderboards
As described above every Workshop map has leaderboard that can be reset by its creator.


New maps list UI
Simple, Custom and Workshop maps UI will look very similar. There's also new search box that works for all song metadata. Maps that include songs will be shown on top.


FOV Scaling 
<80 fov players complained that sometimes they can't see targets. Fixed. It won't matter if u have 160 or 60 fov. Playearea and targets size will be scaled accordingly. There's also MapperFOV in map.json config.


Scoping (ADS) and map part mod
Click right mouse button to aim down sight and decrease your fov and sensitivity. Some maps with "Precise" mode will also have ADS map part modification where targets will be smaller and you suppose to scope in. Don't forget to adjust your settings using mouse-sensitivity.com.


New generator v2 - better beats detection
It would to be tough to explain. Simply speaking it's a lot better. Map.json has new GeneratorVersion option, you can try both versions to compare it with old one.


Intermediate Features
New sliders scoring - multiple points on paths
Added support for 2d image map backgrounds
Validate and redownload workshop map every time it's started
Added "Play Test" button in Workshop music panel
Scoping and ADS song part modification
All simple maps moved to Workshop
Most of the config options added to in-game menu
Inverted mouse option
Recommended song metadata

Minor FeaturesMore jp, kr and pl translations
Better looking sliders paths
Water performance optimization
Better M1911 pistol rapid fire animation
Quieter M1911 pistol shot sound
Currently selected song will be played when hovering over map details panel
Added license button for maps with included music
Maps with music included will be shown on top of the list
Updated discord plugin and game icon
"Only blue targets mod" disabled
Quicker maps generation

FutureNext update is already being planned. Progress can be seen here:

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQhjC70cWAy3T3ZNiZV8S1ZxHtV2QQWm0kBOCrX7Z9kB4UaG-lvIRB_1-dauUjRqHy_nLMaif3Fd_OD/pubchart?oid=598294477&format=image

notes.title: BeatAim 4.10a - Patch Notes - Backup your maps
notes.content:
This patch we mostly focus on improving custom maps. All of them will now be placed in separate folders for upcoming Steam Workshop support. There's automatic custom maps upgrade system but in case it fails you should make backup of your old maps and update them manually if something goes wrong. They are located in "BeatAim\BeatAim_Data\StreamingAssets\CustomMaps~".

You can try the updated before release on development beta in Steam game settings. Help us testing it.

Changes
Added Scaled Difficulty option to Custom Maps - it allows anyone to find perfect settings for their skill level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/e07df783e443bb338ff8615acc7984e4c4b2c808.png
Alt + Tab freeze fixed (by downgrading Unity engine - thx to @Alistair_McF from Rust for the hint)
New Custom Maps format with many benefits (more below)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/e345a5ed09300991c0a970eec978ef2f06c32643.png
[previewyoutube=LMoxh5iAhfk;rightthumb]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LMoxh5iAhfk[/previewyoutube] 
Custom Backgrounds
Targets overlapping protection improvements






Added Ch, Jp, Kr and Latin languages fonts and started community translations project on github.com/kamyker/BeatAim
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/3e9645cf28c899fd3c1e3aa7f8c35fb1743ea23a.png
Custom maps new selection UI - including Scaled and Exact Difficulty modes, new "Open Folder" button, added Dif Tags similar to those in main maps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/b72b50595bad7eb8c5c111ff291d8a27d1c8ca37.png
Map title can be renamed by clicking it in the new panel
Better Generator UI view and fixes for 4:3 aspect ratio
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/37dac368421cc82e29f604cb371e013123f8ec94.png
Added directional sound blending to player config.txt - set it to 1.0 to make music play out of targets to get surround sound and also aim with your ears :)
Default fov changed to 90 vertical and sensitivity to 1.5
Main menu will play any of your added songs instead of only main ones
1 second shorter maps loading - restarting is almost instant
Pop-ups have less transparent background
Fixed "Edit Raw" button not working with songs titled using special characters (for ex. Korean)
Local file browser will show all supported formats (.mp3, .ogg, .wav) at the same time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36026033/1731dbc581e6266be0b0901e55d507c5ab3cc708.png
Fixed very rare bug of few songs not working (aka creep bug)


New Custom Maps formatSongs are no longer placed inside map folders - this allows one song to be used by multiple maps and even Workshop maps won't include them
Many improvements in songs  downloading including placing them in folders grouped by artist name.
Maps have songs metadata, release date, link, title, artist, track number, album.
Added support for multiple difficulties in one map
New Scaled Difficulty works using first (the easiest) and last (the toughest) difficulty - anything between them can be selected by a player
Custom Backgrounds - simply place background.jpg (or .png) - 360 image in your map folder.
Added Custom Backgrounds exposure (reactive brightness to music) and rotation settings
Added Sound Wave rotation and translation settings

Generator UI new buttons:load settings from clipboard

quieter M1911 sound

Custom map import from text/file
Next patch will simplify custom maps import and copy/pasting difficulties across maps and from other players.

Example: to import a song with its difficulty copy text from this link:
pastebin.com
(you can also download this file itself and copy it instead)

To download this song click this button:
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/578253849232670726/634203702453862412/image.png?width=775&height=436

To apply this song difficulty to any other song click edit and then this button:
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/578253849232670726/634204477221765132/image_1.png?width=775&height=436

Osu import
Only beats timings are going to be imported.
[olist]
 Download any osu map, it should have .osz extension
 Change extension to .zip and unpack
 Create folder for your map in 
BeatAim\BeatAim_Data\StreamingAssets\CustomMaps~
 Add map .json config (can copy from any other custom map)
 From unpacked osu map copy music and chosen .osu map file
 In .json config change MusicPath to copied music
[/olist]
